definitions.rationale: Expands the named longestLoopBody proof term into the exact translated loop-body statement.
definitions.text:
rule longestLoopBody =>
    If(Compare(
         Call(Name("len"), Name("string")),
         CmpOp(">", Call(Name("len"), Name("result")))),
       Assign(Name("result"), Name("string")),
       .Stmts)

definitions.rationale: Expands the named longestProgram proof term into the translated module and function AST used by the claims.
definitions.text:
rule longestProgram =>
    Module(
      ImportFrom("typing", "List", "Optional")
      FuncDef("longest", Params("strings"),
        If(Compare(Call(Name("len"), Name("strings")),
                   CmpOp("==", Int(0))),
          Return(NoneVal),
          .Stmts)
        Assign(Name("result"), Subscript(Name("strings"), Int(0)))
        For(Name("string"), Name("strings"), longestLoopBody)
        Return(Name("result"))))

definitions.rationale: Defines the wrapper that converts a mathematical K string sequence into the runtime list representation.
Defines the empty case of the structural conversion from Strings to runtime Values.
Defines the recursive case of the structural conversion from Strings to runtime string values.
Defines the contract summary for an empty input as noneVal.
Defines the nonempty contract summary by seeding the first-longest recurrence with the first string.
Defines the base case of the firstLongest mathematical fold.
Defines the firstLongest recurrence when the next string is strictly longer and becomes the new candidate.
definitions.text:
rule firstLongest(BEST, S:String, SS:Strings)
       => firstLongest(S, SS)
       requires lengthString(S) >Int lengthString(BEST)

definitions.rationale: Defines the firstLongest recurrence when the candidate is retained, including equal-length ties.
definitions.text:
rule firstLongest(BEST, S:String, SS:Strings)
       => firstLongest(BEST, SS)
       requires lengthString(S) <=Int lengthString(BEST)

definitions.rationale: Defines the zero-remaining-elements base case of the firstInSeq summary fold.
definitions.text:
rule firstInSeq(BEST, _ID, _I, N) => BEST
       requires N ==Int 0

definitions.rationale: Defines the firstInSeq recurrence that replaces the candidate when the indexed string is strictly longer.
definitions.text:
rule firstInSeq(BEST, ID, I, N)
       => firstInSeq(stringAt(ID, I), ID, I +Int 1, N -Int 1)
       requires N >Int 0
        andBool lengthString(stringAt(ID, I)) >Int lengthString(BEST)

definitions.rationale: Defines the firstInSeq recurrence that retains the candidate when it is at least as long as the indexed string.
definitions.text:
rule firstInSeq(BEST, ID, I, N)
       => firstInSeq(BEST, ID, I +Int 1, N -Int 1)
       requires N >Int 0
        andBool lengthString(stringAt(ID, I)) <=Int lengthString(BEST)

operational_rules.rationale: Observes a zero-length symbolic sequence as empty in the verification execution model.
operational_rules.text:
rule isEmpty(seqVal(_, _, N)) => boolVal(true)
       requires N ==Int 0

operational_rules.rationale: Observes a positive-length symbolic sequence as nonempty in the verification execution model.
operational_rules.text:
rule isEmpty(seqVal(_, _, N)) => boolVal(false)
       requires N >Int 0

operational_rules.rationale: Defines the runtime head observation for a nonempty symbolic sequence.
operational_rules.text:
rule head(seqVal(ID, I, N)) => strVal(stringAt(ID, I))
       requires N >Int 0

operational_rules.rationale: Terminates symbolic-sequence iteration when its remaining length is zero.
operational_rules.text:
rule forValues(_, seqVal(_, _, N), _) => .
       requires N ==Int 0

operational_rules.rationale: Executes one symbolic-sequence loop iteration, updates the loop variable, and advances the index and remaining length.
operational_rules.text:
rule <k> forValues(X, seqVal(ID, I, N), BODY)
            => exec(BODY)
               ~> forValues(X, seqVal(ID, I +Int 1, N -Int 1), BODY) ... </k>
       <env> (X |-> _OLD REST)
               => (X |-> strVal(stringAt(ID, I)) REST) </env>
       requires N >Int 0
